summary: Addex Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing preclinical results for its GABAB PAM candidate in a chronic cough model. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report incorporating the release into its SEC registration statements. No M&A, activism, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or SPAC transaction is disclosed. The press release describes non-human primate study data, not a corporate event. As a routine current report of business development and scientific progress, this does not constitute a special situation.
